achievements.name: First Power Star
achievements.detail: Collect the Power Star on the opening planet and reach the Comet Observatory.

achievements.name: Grand Star
achievements.detail: Defeat Bowser in a reactor galaxy and return the Grand Star to the observatory.

achievements.name: Hungry Luma
achievements.detail: Feed Star Bits to a Hungry Luma until it turns into a new galaxy.

achievements.name: Bee Mario
achievements.detail: Clear a Power Star while flying in the bee suit.

achievements.name: Boo Mario
achievements.detail: Clear a Power Star while Mario is a Boo.

achievements.name: Purple Coins
achievements.detail: Collect every Purple Coin on a Purple Coin comet.

achievements.name: Daredevil Comet
achievements.detail: Finish a Daredevil comet, where one hit ends the attempt.

achievements.name: Bowser Jr.
achievements.detail: Win a Bowser Jr boss fight and take the Power Star.

achievements.name: Sixty Stars
achievements.detail: Collect 60 Power Stars so the last Bowser galaxy can be entered.

achievements.name: Galaxy Reactor
achievements.detail: Defeat Bowser in the Galaxy Reactor and finish the main rescue.

achievements.name: Luigi Star
achievements.detail: Clear a Power Star while playing as Luigi.

achievements.name: All Power Stars
achievements.detail: Collect all 120 Power Stars listed at the observatory.
